item.subject: science
item.stem: Priya does the half-leaf experiment at home in Pune. She fixes a wide-mouthed bottle containing potassium hydroxide pellets over part of a destarched potted leaf, keeps the plant in sunlight, and later tests both parts of the leaf with iodine. Which result shows that carbon dioxide from the air is essential for the plant to prepare starch?

options.A: The part inside the bottle stays brown with iodine, while the part outside turns blue-black.
options.B: The part inside the bottle turns blue-black, because the plant standing in open air supplies enough carbon dioxide to the whole leaf.
options.C: Both parts of the leaf turn blue-black, because sunlight and chlorophyll alone are enough to make starch.
options.D: Both parts of the leaf stay brown, because a destarched leaf can never make starch again.
